test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

__No sooner did he finished__ his examination than he left for his cricket training centre.

options.text: no sooner than he did finished

solution:
The correct answer is: no sooner did he finish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence contains an error with the use of the verb **"finished"** after **"did."**
 
• When **"did"** is used as an **auxiliary verb**, the **main verb** should be in its **base form **(finish).
 
• The correct construction after "no sooner did" is to use the base form of the verb, which is "finish" in this case.
 
• The phrase "no sooner did he finish" correctly follows the rule of using the base form of the verb after "did."

Therefore, the correct answer is no sooner did he finish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "no sooner than he finished" - Incorrect because** "no sooner" **should be followed by** "did"** and then the** base form** of the **verb**.
 
• Option 3: "no sooner than he did finished" - Incorrect as it redundantly uses **"did" **and **"finished" **together.
 
• Option 4: "no sooner had he finish" - Incorrect because **"had"** should be followed by the **past participle** **"finished,"** not the base form "finish."
